Compare a query tRNA to a reference by Sprinzl label.

Source: R/sprinzl.R
diff_sprinzl.Rd

Aligns two tRNAs through their Sprinzl position labels and classifies each reference position as "match", "substitution" (same label, different base) or "deletion" (label absent from the query). Query positions whose label is absent from the reference are returned separately as insertions.

Usage

diff_sprinzl(reference_coords, reference_id, query_coords, query_id)

Arguments

reference_coords, query_coords

Tibbles of Sprinzl coordinates as returned by read_sprinzl_coords().

reference_id, query_id

The trna_id of the reference and query tRNA within their coordinate tables.

Value

A list with two tibbles:

  • reference: one row per reference position with columns pos, sprinzl_label, ref_base, query_pos, query_base and status.

  • insertions: one row per query-only position with columns query_pos, sprinzl_label, query_base, after_pos and after_label, the reference position (sequence index and Sprinzl label) the inserted base follows. Both are 0/NA at the 5' end.

Examples

ecoli <- read_sprinzl_coords(
  clover_example("sprinzl/ecoliK12_global_coords.tsv.gz")
)
t4 <- read_sprinzl_coords(
  clover_example("sprinzl/phageT4_global_coords.tsv.gz")
)
d <- diff_sprinzl(ecoli, "tRNA-Gly-UCC-1-1", t4, "tRNA-Gly-UCC")
d$reference[d$reference$status != "match", ]
#> # A tibble: 13 × 6
#>      pos sprinzl_label ref_base query_pos query_base status      
#>    <int> <chr>         <chr>        <int> <chr>      <chr>

#>  2     6 6             C                6 U          substitution

#>  4    20 20a           U               NA NA         deletion    
#>  5    31 31            C               30 A          substitution
#>  6    39 39            G               38 U          substitution
#>  7    49 50            C               48 U          substitution
#>  8    51 52            G               50 A          substitution
#>  9    61 62            C               60 U          substitution
#> 10    63 64            G               62 A          substitution
#> 11    64 65            C               63 U          substitution
#> 12    66 67            G               65 A          substitution
#> 13    67 68            C               66 U          substitution
